order_reference: Adjudication Order in the matter of Kavit Industries Limited, passed February 28, 2025 (SEBI Adjudicating Officer Order)
alleged_pattern: Synchronized trades, circular trades, and reversal trades to create artificial volume and a misleading appearance of trading activity in the KIL scrip on BSE.
diagnostic_environment: Local machine (Windows), direct HTTP to NSE archives. NSE homepage returned HTTP 403 (bot-block on homepage). NSE archive returned HTTP 200 without cookie — archive server allows direct download from this IP.

independent_check.result: Kavit Industries Limited / KAVIT absent from NSE currently-listed master under all tested symbol variants (variants: ['KAVIT', 'KAVITIND', 'KAVITINDUSTRIES', 'KIL', 'KAVITINDS', 'KAVITA'])
independent_check.note: This confirms the scrip is not currently NSE-listed. Does not independently confirm historical BSE listing — that would require BSE scrip master access.

KAVIT.bhavcopy_result: NOT FOUND in NSE EQ bhavcopy for probe dates in 2019 window (2019-10-15 [1,494 rows], 2019-08-16 [1,518 rows]) under variants ['KAVIT', 'KAVITIND', 'KAVITINDUSTRIES', 'KIL', 'KAVITINDS', 'KAVITA']. BE series returned 0 rows.
KAVIT.symbol_master_result: NOT in NSE currently-listed symbol master (2,571 symbols). Companies matching 'KAV': only KAVDEFENCE (Kavveri Defence & Wireless Technologies Limited).
KAVIT.conclusion: Not on NSE in 2019 investigation window bhavcopy and not currently listed on NSE. Consistent with BSE-only listing, but BSE listing is not independently confirmed.

overall_conclusion: Kavit Industries Limited (KAVIT) is confirmed absent from NSE under two independent data sources: (1) NSE EQ bhavcopy for probe dates in the 2019 investigation window (2019-10-15 [1,494 rows] and 2019-08-16 [1,518 rows], real HTTP 200 fetches, log-verified), (2) NSE currently-listed equity symbol master (2,571 symbols, real HTTP 200 fetch). The 0-days-fetched result is NOT a code bug — this instrument is not NSE-listed. The specific claim 'confirmed BSE-only' is weaker: both NSE data sources are consistent with BSE-only listing (and SEBI's adjudication order references trading on BSE), but no BSE scrip master lookup was performed to positively confirm BSE listing. The correct description is: 'confirmed not NSE-listed; BSE-only status is the most probable explanation but has not been independently verified against BSE data.'
